text.name: Abu Ghraib
text.rules: Record "credibility hit". If "coalition fractures" has been recorded this game, SAE spends 2 points; otherwise, SAE spends 1 point. Until the end of this turn, points spent by LIO count 1 less, never below 1.
text.history: Photographs of US soldiers abusing detainees at Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison were broadcast on 28 April 2004, damaging the standing of the United States.
